name: What is the difference between orange peel and knockdown texture?
description: Orange peel is a fine-grained bumpy texture, while knockdown starts similar but is flattened with a trowel, creating broader, irregular patterns.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between orange peel and knockdown texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orange peel texture features a subtle, fine-grained bumpy finish, resembling the skin of an orange, and is typically applied with a sprayer. Knockdown texture, on the other hand, starts similarly but is then 'knocked down' or flattened with a trowel after partially drying. This creates a smoother, broader, and more irregular pattern with distinct flat areas. Knockdown offers a slightly more rustic or sophisticated look compared to the uniform appearance of orange peel.
